![快捷欄](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lNxb0JQx/images/8b683b391a6cbf2ce4499f44236986f2019eadce.png)

### 採用 BastiGHG 風格以及 ZickZack V4 150 萬下載量 Black Edition 風格的材質包

它包含快捷欄、自訂天空、覆蓋層、不死图腾、畫作、自訂模型等。

這個材質包會不斷進行調整和改進。如果您發現任何錯誤或有問題/意見，歡迎在鏈接的 Discord 伺服器上開啟票證。

自訂天空與 OptiFine 和 Badlion 完全兼容。Sodium 不支持自訂天空，需要安裝 [Optiboxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/optiboxes)。Core Shader 也會將快捷欄中經驗值的數字顏色改為合適的白色。

這個材質包未獲得 BastiGHG、Badlion 或 ZickZack Cosmetics 的認可，也與他們無關。它是原始材質包的自訂版本/諷刺作品。

<details>
<summary>English Description</summary>

### A texture pack in the style of BastiGHG and the 1,5 million Black Edition of ZickZackV5

It contains Hotbar, Custom Sky, Overlay, Totem of Undying, Paintings, customised models and more.

This texture pack is constantly being adapted and improved. If you find any bugs or have questions/concerns, feel free to open a ticket on the linked Discord server.

The Custom Sky is compatible with OptiFine and Badlion without any problems. Sodium does not support custom skies and requires the installation of [Optiboxes](https://modrinth.com/mod/optiboxes). Core Shader also changes the color of the XP number in the hotbar to a fresh white.

This texture pack is not approved by or associated with BastiGHG, Badlion or ZickZack Cosmetics. It is a customised version/parody of the original pack.

</details>
